title: Loft: a 20 x 20 square up into a circle r10, 30 mm higher

expect.note: Between two profiles a loft joins matching points by straight lines; OpenCASCADE matches the square's corners with the circle's points at 45 degrees and runs each side and its quarter arc at even speed. A section at height t h is (1-t) P + t Q, of area (1-t)^2 A_P + t^2 A_Q + t (1-t) M with M = 16 sqrt(2) s r / pi (s the half side), so V = h (A_P / 3 + A_Q / 3 + M / 6).
